Every number, interval, hedge, null and UNKNOWN was moved, never dropped; the diff is 79 insertions / 73 deletions in one file.

research/autonomy/research-ledger.json — AUT-049 lease released and its blocked_evidence re-derived from a live bar reading; AUT-PROP-049 filed (the sha-bound round that closes the remaining three clauses as ONE act); AUT-PD-142 filed (the lint_readability splitter defect, filed NOT fixed — see below).

⚠ SPLITTING A LONG SENTENCE CAN UN-CLEAR A `lint_claims` RULE, AND IT DID HERE — caught by preflight, root-caused, and fixed in the prose rather than in the rule. R2-treats-cures carries `clears_on="disclaimer"`, and the clearing scope is the SENTENCE: the word 'treats' in "§6's falsifier #1 treats a single counter-report as sufficient to overturn it" had been sitting inside the 167-word sentence, whose many 'no'/'not' markers cleared it. Splitting that sentence left 'treats' alone in a sentence with no negation, so the rule fired as a real ERROR. Reworded to 'counts' — identical meaning, no regulated word, pattern untouched (CLAUDE.md §1: fix the doc, don't loosen the pattern). lint_claims: 1 ERROR -> 0 ERROR, 165 WARN unchanged. ⭐ NO NEW RULE IS OWED: scientific-writing §3 step 5 already says to re-run the screen and the content gates together, and that is exactly what caught it.

⚠ SPLITTING SENTENCES DILUTES CLAIM COVERAGE, AND THE NUMBER IS RECORDED RATHER THAN LEFT FOR SOMEONE TO DISCOVER. research/manuscripts/claim-coverage.json regenerated (it is a deposit artifact and preflight refuses a stale one): this document goes 270 -> 303 censused sentences and 84 -> 89 covered, so the COUNT of covered sentences rose while the RATIO fell 0.311 -> 0.294. The mechanism is structural, not a lapse: a guard witnessing one long sentence witnesses only one of the parts it is split into, and the other parts land uncovered. ⛔ ANY LATER CLAUSE-7 PASS ON ANOTHER PAPER WILL DO THE SAME THING — 270 over-ceiling sentences remain across the portfolio, so this is a standing interaction between two bars and not a one-off. It is not hidden by a floor: test_claim_coverage_has_not_regressed compares the committed artifact against a fresh computation, so the ratio move is visible in the diff of every such commit.

⭐ ONE BOUND SENTENCE WAS RESTORED RATHER THAN THE GUARD RE-ANCHORED. test_fusion_partner_prose_matches_its_artifact binds §3.1's two counts through the literal construction `— (\w+), of which (\w+) enters the primary pool`, and the split had removed it. That guard's own docstring permits re-anchoring when the sentence says the same thing in different words — but re-anchoring a guard to fit the edit that broke it is the move this loop distrusts, so the construction was put back instead, attached to the end of a 36-word sentence. NOT ONE CHARACTER OF ANY GUARD WAS EDITED THIS CYCLE, and the readability check still passes.

Re-splitting the 17 findings on the glyph boundary showed 2 of them are ENTIRELY an artefact (86w whose real parts are 46w and 40w; 70w whose real parts are 15w and 55w) and 5 more were reported longer than any real sentence in them. All 17 were split in the prose instead, the 2 artefacts included. The defect is filed as AUT-PD-142 with its measurement, for a later cycle.
